title.narrative: TVET, Literacy, Higher Education, STEM Education

description.narrative: Technical support will be provided for revising the curriculum in TVET sector and further work on detailing Higher Education Qualification Farmwork and disseminating it. Additional technical assistance will be provided for the future landscaping higher education in Nepal. Furthermore, ntegrating Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics (STEAM) into school education The integration of STEAM education into the curriculum, as prioritized by Nepal’s National Education Policy 2076, is essential for fostering a holistic and interdisciplinary approach to learning that equips students with the necessary skills for the future. Integrating STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics) education not only enhances students' engagement and motivation by connecting academic content to real-life contexts but also equips them with the knowledge and skills necessary to address contemporary challenges such as climate change, economic development, and social equity. In this context, UNESCO aims at supporting the government to better understand the needs and priorities in STEAM education, ensuring more effective integration for improved learning outcomes and helping learners become responsible and active citizens.
